section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.1) presents intraclass correlations (ICCs) and within- and between-persons correlations for study variables from what appears to be a daily diary study. The analysis examines relationships between exposure to body-focused and non-body-focused others with criteria variables including body appreciation, intuitive eating, and dietary restraint. Key findings indicate that exposure to body-focused others was negatively associated with body appreciation and intuitive eating at the between-persons level, while exposure to non-body-focused others was positively associated with intuitive eating.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents zero-order correlations, intraclass correlations (ICCs), and descriptive statistics for study variables from a daily diary study. The table shows that body appreciation had a negative between-persons correlation with BMI (r = -.24) and a strong positive within-persons correlation with body satisfaction (r = .77). Exposure to body-focused others was associated with lower body appreciation and higher dietary restraint at the between-persons level.
